marta (AE): Heads up — new POC request from Northbank. They require a walled‑garden deployment (no internet egress, transfer via controlled USB or internal registry). Need clarity on installer format, patch cadence, offline license activation, and any blockers for a 3‑week trial. Who can scope?
jordan (SE): I can take it. Two offline packaging options: a single signed tarball (recommended) or OCI archive for a closed registry. We support signed delta patches for updates. Agent verifies signatures on boot. Example verify: ```cosign verify --key ./redwood.pub manifest.json``` :eyes:
sam (SRE): For a small POC we recommend 1–2 GPU nodes (e.g. A40) for typical interactive load. CPU‑only quantized bundles are possible but expect higher latency. Telemetry/health pings are optional and can be disabled; we provide an offline log-collection script.
arun (security): We'll need their vendor security questionnaire. We can supply SBOM, artifact attestations, signed manifests, and an ISV security pack. Ask them whether they require FIPS-certified crypto or on-prem HSM integration for key wrapping. Offline license file activation is supported but we need their acceptance flow.
olivia (PS): Pricing note — 30‑day POC is complimentary. Production/reserved capacity pricing is separate; offline packaging and one-off signing are included during POC; ongoing offline lifecycle support requires enterprise plan. I'll draft the pricing blurb for the SOW.
jordan (SE): Upgrade cadence: default for closed networks is monthly bundle deltas; we can do quarterly cadence for strict change control. Emergency security fixes can be issued as an out‑of‑band signed patch. Rollback to previous signed bundle is supported.
marta (AE): Can someone produce a one‑page POC runbook + clear acceptance criteria? Customer wants it by EOD tomorrow. Also need rough tarball sizes for transfer window planning.
sam (SRE): Rough sizing: base runtime image ~2.5GB (CPU), model bundle depends on family — quantized LLMs ~8–12GB. Delta updates typically <100MB unless model weights change. Will confirm sizes when they pick model variant.
arun (security): Legal will ask about telemetry and logs. We can offer "no telemetry" option and provide an offline logs collector plus instructions to upload to their SIEM. We can share our SOC2 report under NDA and provide contact for security MSA items.
olivia (PS): I'll draft the pricing/license note and SOW bullet points. Jordan/sam/arun — please attach SBOM, manifest example, runbook snippet, and any certs in the thread.
jordan (SE): Runbook snippet (paste): ```- Kickoff: confirm hardware & transfer window
- Deliverable: signed tarball + manifest + install script
- Activation: offline license file + local KMS config (if used)
- Acceptance: run 10 sample prompts from provided set, latency <200ms p50 (GPU) or baseline agreed
- Rollback: install previous signed bundle from /opt/redwood/archives```:thumbsup:
marta (AE): Great, thanks — I'll sync with the customer and propose kickoff Thu 10am PT. I'll include the acceptance criteria and ask them to send the security questionnaire PDF.
deploy-bot: New signed bundle created: bundle-2025-11-14.tar.gz (manifest signed).
marta (AE): Perfect. If you add the SBOM and cosign pubkey I'll attach them to the NDA packet and send to Northbank. Thanks everyone :pray:
